end.summary:
Practised shared ideas across festivals, stories, and values.
Compared Pongal and Lohri using same/different features.
Explained that stories can remain shared while languages and retellings vary.
Compared dosa and chilla with a Venn-style shared/different description.
Teach-back on unity in diversity was not completed.
end.parentNote: Riya practised finding common threads beneath different festivals, languages, stories, and foods. They used the comparison method well by naming both shared and different features, such as Pongal and Lohri and dosa and chilla. In the final example, they identified shared mithai and different practices, but the idea that meeting and sharing can build unity was not yet connected; this was not corrected later in the lesson. At home, ask Riya to compare two festivals and finish with one sentence about how their differences enrich people’s shared life.
